description_expanded: ABOUT SEA LA VIE: Experience the perfect blend of comfort and coastal charm at Carillon Beach Resort Unit 306. This inviting studio condo comfortably accommodates up to four guests, featuring a king-sized bed and a queen sleeper sofa. Wake up to breathtaking views of the serene water, creating a peaceful and picturesque start to your day. Located just 2 miles from Scenic 30A and a mere 4 miles from Pier Park in Panama City Beach, this unit places you at the heart of everything the Emerald Coast has to offer. Whether you're here for a quick getaway, an extended stay, or even considering a longer-term escape, Unit 306 provides the ideal setting. Surrounded by the harmonious backdrop of sea, sand, and sun, along with lush natural landscapes and timeless architecture, this condo offers a truly unique and memorable experience. Enjoy the beauty and tranquility of Carillon Beach Resort, where every day feels like a vacation. ABOUT THE AREA: Carillon Beach Resort on the Emerald Coast is the perfect destination for a relaxing and adventurous getaway. Start your stay with a stroll down Carillon Market Street, where you can explore charming shops, savor local cuisine at various eateries, and admire art in galleries. The resort also offers a pristine one-mile stretch of private beach with seven exclusive access points, providing a serene and uncrowded beach experience. For those seeking outdoor activities, the resort has something for everyone. Enjoy walks through scenic parks, swim in one of the resort's pools, play tennis, or engage in more adventurous pursuits like kayaking, snorkeling, and fishing. Guests can also rent bikes, stand-up paddleboards, or kayaks to explore the beautiful surroundings. Wellness is a priority at Carillon Beach Resort, with offerings like rejuvenating yoga classes at Yoga Elements and luxurious tropical treatments at Salon Baliage & Spa. Dining options at the resort cater to all tastes, from casual meals at Our Little Beach Cafe to gourmet experiences at Gratify. The Shipwreck General Store provides a convenient spot for shopping, whether you're looking for essentials or unique souvenirs. Families will find plenty to keep the kids entertained, including basketball and tennis courts, a playground, and easy beach access. Additionally, the resort offers a gym with flexible rates. For a spiritual touch, the on-site chapel offers Sunday services, adding to the resort's tranquil atmosphere. Whether you're here for the beach, the activities, or simply to unwind, Carillon Beach Resort delivers a perfect blend of relaxation, recreation, and luxury. This is the ultimate destination for those looking to experience the best of the Emerald Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * Carillon Beach Walkover #7 PARKING: * $35 per Vehicle PROPERTY RULES: PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Must be at least 25 years old to rent * No pets allowed ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests. *Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to the properties we manage may go under construction without being notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
